title: Monthly Meetings
bodyHtml:
The Guild of Harwich Artists hold monthly meetings January through May, and September through November, 1:30-3:45pm, at the Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak Street, Harwich, MA. Each meeting consists of a well-known Cape artist demonstrator. All programs are free and open to the public. Come join the fun!

Read more about our Monthly Meetings and Guest Artists

2024 Guest Presenters

  • September: Mary Wojciechowski (Alcohol Ink)
  • October: Paul Schulenburg (Oil Portrait)
  • November:  Wendi Smith (Pastels)
